process: Underground coal mining, in-mine CH4 (IPCC default range)
note: m3 of CH4 per tonne of coal (run-of-mine presumed; the brief writes only 'm3/tonne'). Printed range from ref. [9] Irving and Tailakov (2002), IPCC Good Practice Guidance background paper - national-average default coefficients, not measurements at a mine. Emission rates EXCLUDE recovered (drained and used) methane: 'These emissions rates exclude recovered emissions' (p.1); national inventories subtract recovery separately (p.5). Released from the seam and surrounding strata during mining, mostly through the ventilation air (ventilation keeps CH4 below 1%, p.5). Country coefficients (Table 5, e.g. United States 11.0-15.3) are in the _methane-country-coefficients sidecar. ADDITIVE STAGES: a mine's gross CH4 is the in-mine (mining) coefficient PLUS the post-mining coefficient (summary p.12 prints them joined with '+'); the two stage processes are distinguished by process-step and must not be pooled as alternatives.
